description: Auditor never self-resolves issue/branch identity by bare number; runPlanPhase hands it a resolved issue record and identity checks use git refs only, killing the numeric-coincidence false-BLOCK class.

userStories.title: Embed the resolved issue record + derived branch into the auditor spawn payload
userStories.description: As the deterministic plan runner, I need to hand the auditor the already-resolved issue record (id, title, description, acceptanceCriteria) and the code-derived branchName in its spawn prompt, so the auditor never has to re-resolve which issue the PRD targets and a coincident GitHub PR number can no longer trigger a false-BLOCK.
acceptanceCriteria: A new pure exported builder in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts (e.g. buildAuditorTaskPrompt(issue, branchName)) embeds the resolved issue id, title, description, and spec.acceptanceCriteria plus the derived branchName verbatim into the auditor task-prompt string. [oracle: bun test]

The derived branchName embedded in the payload is cam/issue-<numericSuffix> computed in code from the resolved issue (via the numeric suffix of issue.id / prd.issueNumber, reusing deriveBranchName), never a planner-authored slug. [oracle: bun test]

runPlanWorkerSequence spawns the auditor with the record-bearing prompt built from the selected IssueEntry rather than the static DEFAULT_AUDITOR_TASK_PROMPT, and the re-plan rounds in runPlanPhaseWithReplan inherit the same record-bearing auditor prompt. [oracle: bun test]

A regression test reproduces the CAM-156 scenario: a local IssueEntry with id 'CAM-156' selected while a coincident GitHub PR #156 exists, and asserts the auditor spawn payload carries the fully-resolved CAM-156 record (title/description/acceptanceCriteria/branch cam/issue-156) so bare-number resolution is never needed, and that runPlanPhase issues no gh invocation for issue/PR identity. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts (add buildAuditorTaskPrompt, wire it into runPlanWorkerSequence replacing the static DEFAULT_AUDITOR_TASK_PROMPT default; keep opts.auditorTaskPrompt override for backward compat), test/supervisor/plan/*.test.ts. The selected issue is already available as `issue: IssueEntry` inside runPlanWorkerSequence; derive the branch from its id suffix (reuse deriveBranchName, plan-runner.ts:87). IssueEntry.spec?.acceptanceCriteria may be undefined (guard per noUncheckedIndexedAccess). This realizes ADR-0027 + the CAM-197 principle: identity resolution is done by deterministic code and handed to the LLM as payload, never re-derived by the model. The regression test cannot run a real LLM; assert the deterministic contract (payload embeds the record; runner argv contains no `gh` identity call). Keep the module pure over injected deps.

userStories.title: Auditor audits the provided record only; identity/collision checks use git refs, prior-art is git-log and non-blocking
userStories.description: As the PRD auditor, I need my instructions to audit against the issue record provided in my spawn prompt and to never re-resolve issue/branch identity against any backend, so that in issue_system=local I issue zero gh identity queries, flag a branch-collision only for a branch that actually exists, and treat prior-art as non-blocking.
acceptanceCriteria: Both .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md and templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md instruct the auditor to audit the PRD against the issue record PROVIDED in its spawn prompt and to never re-resolve issueNumber/branchName against any backend (zero gh query for issue/PR identity when issue_system=local). [oracle: grep -qi 'never re-resolve' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]

The branch-collision check in both auditor files is defined against real git refs (local ref plus git ls-remote origin) and explicitly never against a same-numbered GitHub PR; a branch that does not exist is never flagged as a collision. [oracle: grep -q 'ls-remote' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]

Any prior-art / duplication signal in both auditor files is sourced from git history (git log, backend-agnostic) and emitted as non-blocking (suggestion/WARNING), never critical/BLOCK. [oracle: grep -qi 'prior-art' .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]

The change is applied to BOTH the templates/ source-of-truth copy and the .claude/ runtime mirror (intentional self-hosting). [oracle: grep -qi 'never re-resolve' templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md]
Vendor drift check passes after regenerating the embedded copy (bun run embed-vendor). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md, templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md, then `bun run embed-vendor` to sync src/vendor/_generated.ts. patterns.md:46 (agent-prompt self-hosting): edit BOTH copies + embed-vendor; call it out in the commit as intentional self-hosting so a later auditor does not flag harness drift (F.23 already whitelists declared self-hosting edits). Lesson 'cam dual-copy is per-file': the two auditor files are NOT byte-identical (.claude is cam-cli-customized, templates is the generic scaffold) - add the identity/collision/prior-art guardrail to the equivalent sections of each (Inputs, checklist A.completeness, E.invariants) without clobbering their existing divergent wording. Revise the current 'Read those files yourself. Do not trust summaries in the invocation prompt.' line: for the ISSUE RECORD the auditor must now TRUST the deterministic-code-resolved payload (ADR-0027 / CAM-197), it still reads prd.json (the PRD under audit) itself. templatesContents byte-parity test in test/embedded.test.ts catches embed drift.
